address: GF, Pacquiao Mansion, 324 H.V. Dela Costa,, Makati - Metro Manila, 1227, The Philippines
bio: This inviting neighbourhood eatery centres on binchotan-grilled meats, with beef from Japan, Australia and the USA taking the lead. Vibrant skewers, prawn toast, croquettes and dumplings show global flair and Asian influences. There's generosity in both flavours and portions, but also flexibility. Drop by for cocktails and small plates or settle in for a full celebratory feast. The friendly team are happy to guide you through the menu.
